editorial.blurb: A tucked-away gem serving authentic Indian and Nepali cuisine with a lunch buffet that draws neighborhood crowds for its unique chat items, traditional curries, and fresh naan.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the lunch buffet around noon when it's uncrowded and freshest—skip Mondays to avoid Sunday leftovers. Order custom spicing if you go à la carte to get exactly the heat level you want.
